quotations.old_english: Be sceápes gonge mid his flése
quotations.english: of a sheep's going with its fleece

source_text: flés, es; n. A FLEECE; vellus :-- Be sceápes gonge mid his flése of a sheep's going with its fleece, L. In. 69; Th. i. 146, 9, note 20, MS. G. v. flýs.
